pathAssistantSteps.info:
What to do:

  • Review lead details and leverage sales tools for insights
  • Add to a Gong Engage flow, send an outreach email, or make a call
  • Log all outreach activities in Salesforce
  • Update status to Contacted once a two-way interaction has occurred

Policy reminders:

  • Track Activity Count. Outreach attempts must be logged
  • Do not advance to Contacted without a confirmed two-way interaction

Key Fields: Accepted Date | Phone | Mobile

What to do:

  • Qualify the lead using IRM qualification criteria
  • Confirm need, product/BU interest, budget, authority, and timeframe
  • Update status to Converted, Nurture, or Disqualified. Do not leave stalled in Contacted

Policy reminders:

  • Need Confirmed is mandatory before advancing
  • Next Step and Next Step Date are required
  • A confirmed two-way interaction is required to reach this status

Key Fields:Field | Need Confirmed | Next Step| Next Step Date| Budget Identified

What to do:

  • Confirm the lead meets qualification criteria before converting.
  • Convert to an Account, Contact, and/or Opportunity as appropriate
  • Verify Role and full address are populated as these are required to convert

Policy reminders:

  • Street, City, State/Province, Zip/Postal Code, Country, and Contact Role are all required
  • Do not convert leads that do not meet qualification criteria. Instead, use Nurture or Disqualified

Key Fields: Contact Role | Street | City| State/Province/County | Zip/Postal Code

What to do:

  • Select the Disqualified Reason. This determines whether the lead enters a reactivation nurture or is permanently suppressed from all Marketing lists
  • Ensure the reason accurately reflects why the lead does not qualify

Policy reminders:

  • Disqualified Reason is required to save this status
  • Poor fit leads (wrong ICP, not aligned to services) may be permanently removed. Choose your reason carefully
  • This action returns the lead to Marketing for final disposition

Key Fields: Disqualified Reason| Primary Product Interest| Need Confirmed| Budget Identified | Description

What to do:

  • Review lead assignment and confirm it is a valid person/company- Confirm you are the right owner or escalate if misrouted
  • Accept the lead to commit to follow-up

Policy reminders:

  • Leads must not sit unworked in New
  • Accepting a lead requires Next Step and Next Step Date
  • Check Lead Score and Re-engaged Lead flag before accepting

Key Fields:Lead Score | Primary Product Interest | Do Not Email / Do Not Call| Description

What to do:

  • Select the Nurture Reason. This drives which Marketing campaign the lead is enrolled in
  • Ensure the lead record is complete and contact preferences are accurately set before returning to Marketing

Policy reminders:

  • Nurture Reason is required to save this status
  • Use Nurture when timing is wrong or the lead is unresponsive, not when the lead is a poor fit (use Disqualified)

Key Fields: Nurture Reason| Primary Product Interest | Do Not Email | Description
